_readme: Sign-offs for configs.unverified_items(): id -> {reader, archive, sha256, retrieved, note}, or for an 'all:' item {by_harness: {harness: entry}} (one entry per harness, because the claim is checked per harness). A reader other than the committer checks the item against a vendor document archived as a file inside this repository; sha256 is the file's hash, retrieved an ISO date. An entry of kind 'measured' (no vendor document says it; a preflight proves it before every run) names an evidence file instead of an archive. run --execute checks them (run.signoff_problems), refuses an entry whose note starts with NOT SUPPORTED, and stores the hash of this set in every row. EVERY reader here is an AI agent of a round-3 lane (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini lanes) reading archived text and checking its own measurements: author self-review, not an independent or human reader. The integrator merged the lanes' files; Cursor has no sign-offs and is refused.

codex.reader_kind: AI agent of the r3-codex lane: author self-review, not an independent or human reader
codex.note: MEASURED, NOT DOCUMENTED: the vendor docs are silent on the shell's PATH, and Codex ran the command as /bin/zsh -lc, which reorders PATH on macOS, so the PATH touch shim was skipped (first stub run). The Codex stub arm calls the shim by absolute path (configs.stub_script shim_dir) and run.shim_smoke(absolute=True) must attest before every shell run. The earlier sign-off text 'NOT SUPPORTED for Codex as worded' is why this entry is a measured one and no vendor document is cited.
